objects.label: Accounts
objects.description: A customer or vendor relationship. Internal name Account; the UI says Customer.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: The business identity. Sorting and prefix search run against `nameLower` (below), because Firestore cannot compare case-insensitively and a query against the display name could not find "Mesquite Soda Works" for "mesquite".

fields.label: Customer (sort key)
fields.description: Normalized lowercase copy of `name`. The only case-insensitive handle Firestore has.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: PROSPECT IS A STATUS, not a separate type and not a separate collection. There is no second Customer identity model to avoid creating — the distinction is already a field.

fields.label: Relationship
fields.description: Multi-valued: an account can be both a customer and a vendor.

fields.label: Line of Business
fields.description: Informational only — gates no authorization, and an unset value renders nothing rather than silently defaulting to Taylor.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Free-form labels. Filtering is not claimed until the index exists.

fields.label: Default Currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code (e.g. USD), stored uppercase. Validated against a fixed code set by domain/commercialProfile.js's isValidIso4217() — not a monetary amount, so not CURRENCY_MINOR.

fields.label: PO Required
fields.description: AccountDetail.jsx only renders this when a real boolean is stored (account.purchaseOrderRequired === true or === false) — a malformed stored value is surfaced in the edit form, never silently shown as Yes/No.

fields.label: Invoice Delivery
fields.description: Process metadata only — how an invoice is delivered, not a monetary value. Validated by domain/commercialProfile.js's isValidInvoiceDeliveryMethod().

fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.description: GOVERNED — admin-only edit, enforced in firestore.rules (customer.governedField.write), not by UI hiding. Optional; absent means no default term is set. See the field comment above for why no capability is declared here.

fields.label: Tax Status
fields.description: GOVERNED — admin-only edit (customer.governedField.write). An absent stored value means UNKNOWN, never TAXABLE (domain/commercialProfile.js's resolveTaxStatus() safe default) — a list or detail surface rendering this field must apply that same resolution, not render a blank.

fields.label: Billing Contact
fields.description: Stored at billingContact.contactId on the document. Must belong to THIS Account — domain/commercialProfile.js's isContactOnAccount() rejects a contact id from another Account. Display resolution belongs to the contact entity, not to this field.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: Stored at accountOwner.assignedToEmployeeId, one of seven fields in the stored Person Assignment map. See the field comment above for which of the other six are deliberately left undeclared, and why.

fields.label: Customer #
fields.description: Reserved external identifier — passthrough only (domain/accounts.js header). Not validated or enforced-unique.

fields.label: ERP ID
fields.description: Reserved external identifier — passthrough only (domain/accounts.js header). Not validated or enforced-unique.

fields.label: Accounting ID
fields.description: Reserved external identifier — passthrough only (domain/accounts.js header). Not validated or enforced-unique.

fields.label: Legacy ID
fields.description: Reserved external identifier — passthrough only (domain/accounts.js header). Not validated or enforced-unique.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Free-form text. Rendered verbatim; no formatting or length constraint found in any write path.

fields.label: Billing Address
fields.description: Structured { street, city, state, zip }, every part optional; the whole object is written or cleared together. Not filterable or sortable — Firestore cannot order by a map, and no projected scalar exists to filter on.

objects.label: Contacts
objects.description: A person at a customer account. No standalone route; reached through the Account record.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A single stored name, not a first/last split. Every write path agrees on this one.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: Free text. No canonical vocabulary exists; the importer accepts any value.

fields.label: Primary
fields.description: Uniqueness is NOT enforced by storage — more than one contact can carry it, and the Account surface reports that rather than hiding it.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: The parent scope. Every read of contacts is account-scoped.

objects.label: Customer Locations
objects.description: A physical site belonging to one Account — a customer's office, plant, or delivery address. Reached only through the Account record today; no standalone route exists.

fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: The human reference for this site. Required at create (LocationCreateModal blocks an empty/whitespace-only submit). Not enforced unique — an Account can have two sites with the same name.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: The owning Account. Enforced by firestore.rules elsewhere (equipmentLocationBelongsToAccount reads this field on the referenced Location to confirm it matches the referencing Equipment's own accountId) — not by any rule on this collection's own match block, which validates nothing. Set once at create (domain/locations.js createLocation) and never changed by any write path found.

fields.label: Street Address
fields.description: Stored at `address.street` on the document (shared/address/AddressFields.jsx), one of four scalar strings under the `address` map. See the file header for why this is a flat id and why it is four fields, not one struct.

fields.label: City
fields.description: Stored at `address.city` on the document — see the file header.

fields.label: State
fields.description: Stored at `address.state` on the document — see the file header.

fields.label: ZIP
fields.description: Stored at `address.zip` on the document — see the file header.

fields.label: Access Notes
fields.description: Optional. LocationCreateModal stores null when the field is left blank (`accessNotes.trim() || null`), never an empty string.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds (Date.now(), domain/locations.js makeCollectionStore add()), never a Firestore Timestamp. Never refreshed after create. No createdBy is stored.

fields.label: Updated
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds (Date.now(), domain/locations.js updateLocation()), never a Firestore Timestamp. No updatedBy is stored.

objects.label: Opportunities
objects.description: A pursued piece of business. Deny-all in Rules; read only through governed callables.

fields.label: Opportunity
fields.description: OPP-YYYY-######, allocated transactionally at creation and never rewritten.

fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: Null while open. WON only from DECISION; LOST from any open stage.

fields.label: Expected value
fields.description: Stored as a plain number with no currency field. NOT minor units; do not render a currency symbol the data does not justify.

fields.label: Expected close
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds, not a Firestore Timestamp — unlike createdAt on the same document.

fields.label: Need
fields.description: The nearest thing to a human name this entity has, and it is optional.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: Display resolution belongs to the employee entity, not to this list.

fields.label: Sales Order
fields.description: Written only after a WON opportunity produces a Sales Order. Its presence is the duplicate guard.

objects.label: Sales Orders
objects.description: The committed commercial order following a WON Opportunity. Deny-all in Rules; read only through governed callables.

fields.label: Sales Order
fields.description: SO-YYYY-######, server-allocated at creation and immutable. Not yet returned by the read projection — see the file header.

fields.label: Dollars
fields.description: Sum of every line's ordered extended price (orderedQty x committed unitPrice), integer minor units. Null unless every line is priced — see pricingState.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Free-form string (e.g. "USD"); no amount is stored in minor units anywhere on this record.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: The scope listSalesOrdersForAccount actually queries by.

fields.label: Owner
fields.description: Display resolution belongs to the employee entity, not to this list.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: The delivery/service Location. Optional in storage — string | null (salesOrderCommands.ts) — not every Sales Order has one set.

fields.label: Source Opportunity
fields.description: Written only by createSalesOrderFromOpportunity. Preserves the Opportunity -> Sales Order lineage.

fields.label: Source Agreement
fields.description: The accepted Sales Agreement this order fulfils. Written by both WON paths since Slice 4 D2; null on orders predating it and on orders created directly — honestly null, never backfilled.

fields.label: Source Opportunity #
fields.description: Denormalized at creation so the lineage link can render a reference, not a document id. Null for Sales Orders predating Opportunity identity.

objects.label: Work Orders
objects.description: A unit of field service work, moving through a governed lifecycle.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Scope for every 'this account's work' question. A reference, never a label.

fields.label: Equipment
fields.description: The installed unit this work is about. Absent on legacy records and on INSTALL work, where the unit is created at completion rather than named at creation.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: Where the work happens. A reference; the site name lives on the location.

fields.label: Technician
fields.description: Display resolution belongs to the employee entity, not to this list.

objects.label: Parts Catalog
objects.description: A catalog record: descriptive identity only. Stock, cost and supplier data live in other authorities.

fields.label: Part ID
fields.description: The Firestore document id. partFromFirestore throws if the stored partId does not match it.

fields.label: Part Number
fields.description: The catalog number staff use. Required on every Part; the referenceField half of identity.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Required on every Part; the nameField half of identity.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Optional, free text. No canonical vocabulary exists on the domain type.

fields.label: Stocking Class
fields.description: STOCKED / NON_STOCK / SERVICE / KIT — what kind of catalog line this is, not how many are on hand.

fields.label: Control Type
fields.description: PART MASTER's own tracking vocabulary — STANDARD / SERIALIZED / LOT / SERIALIZED_LOT. NOT the inventory ledger's `trackingMode`: partMaster/controlTypeTrackingMode.ts is the one mapping between them, and it exists because the mapping had already been copied twice. A surface showing one under the other's name is how two screens come to disagree about whether a part is counted by quantity or by serial.

fields.label: Manufacturer
fields.description: Stored as primaryManufacturerId; the domain type (functions/src/partMaster/types.ts) calls the same field manufacturerId. No manufacturer entity is registered in this program yet, so this stays a plain id rather than a REFERENCE this registry cannot resolve.

fields.label: Manufacturer Part Number
fields.description: Stored as primaryManufacturerPartNumber; the domain type calls it manufacturerPartNumber. Optional.

fields.label: OEM Status
fields.description: Optional.

fields.label: Item Type
fields.description: Written to the document ONLY when true; absent otherwise, never stored as false.

fields.label: Equipment Model
fields.description: Legal ONLY when wholeUnit is true (enforced by validatePart at the command layer, not by Rules or this metadata). The stored value is the equipment_models document id, verified canonical and checked to exist by assertEquipmentModelExists on every write — see the file header.

fields.label: Warehouse Available
fields.description: getPartBalance → available (onHand − reserved, ACTIVE warehouses only, EXCLUDES truck stock). Not stored on the Part; resolved per part where a balance read has already run.

fields.label: On Order
fields.description: getPartBalance → onOrder, the canonical outstanding inbound. This metadata consumes that projection and re-implements none of its SENT-counts / APPROVED-does-not rules.

fields.label: Reorder Point
fields.description: Calculated from usage, NOT stored on the Part.

fields.label: Unit Cost
fields.description: BLOCKED — the canonical Part carries no cost of any kind. See PART_INVENTORY_VALUATION_AUTHORITY_GAP.

fields.label: Sell Price
fields.description: BLOCKED — no sell or list price exists on the Part.

fields.label: Business Line
fields.description: BLOCKED — the Part carries no operating company. See PART_BUSINESS_LINE_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE.

fields.label: Truck Stock
fields.description: BLOCKED — onHand is warehouse-only by design and no mobile figure is projected. Showing warehouse stock under a company-wide label is the FALSE_COMFORT failure.

fields.label: Preferred Supplier
fields.description: BLOCKED — there is no preferredSupplierId ON the Part. PartSupplierItem{partId, supplierId, preferred} is a separate collection, and collapsing a many-to-many into one column would hide every other supplier.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Repository-owned optimistic-concurrency counter, starting at 1. Never caller-supplied.

fields.label: Created By
fields.description: Actor uid. Repository-owned; every stored Part carries one (readMeta rejects a record missing it).

fields.label: Updated By
fields.description: Actor uid. Repository-owned; every stored Part carries one.

objects.label: Inventory Stock
objects.description: An append-only stock-movement ledger entry — the sole source of stock-movement truth (ADR-003). Two disjoint stored shapes share this collection: legacy Work-Order reservation entries and operational movement entries (Receiving/Transfer/Cycle Count) — see the file header.

fields.label: Transaction ID
fields.description: The Firestore document id. Not written into the document body by any live writer.

fields.label: Part
fields.description: The Part this movement concerns. Present on every stored document, legacy or operational. Not filtered — see the file header.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: This entity is identityMode SYSTEM_ONLY — `type` is NOT identity, it is the first field a composed description should draw from. See the file header. RESERVED/RELEASED/CONSUMED are legacy-only; RECEIVED/TRANSFER_IN/TRANSFER_OUT/ADJUSTED are operational-only.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: A unit count, never a monetary amount. Positive on RESERVED/RELEASED/CONSUMED/RECEIVED/TRANSFER_IN/TRANSFER_OUT (and always exactly 1 when the moving Part is SERIAL-tracked); signed (nonzero, may be negative) on ADJUSTED, the one direction: SIGNED movement type (validateQuantityReason, operationalMovementValidation.ts).

fields.label: Work Order
fields.description: Legacy-only (RESERVED/RELEASED/CONSUMED). Absent on every operational (RECEIVED/TRANSFER_IN/TRANSFER_OUT/ADJUSTED) document — see the file header.

fields.label: Recorded
fields.description: Legacy-only. Server-authored (FieldValue.serverTimestamp() in writeLedgerEntry()). Absent on every operational document, which carries recordedAt instead — see the file header.

fields.label: Schema Version
fields.description: Operational-only; always 2 (OPERATIONAL_LEDGER_SCHEMA_VERSION). Absent on every legacy document — its absence is the actual runtime discriminator classifyLedgerDoc() switches on. Not filterable or sortable: one constant value.

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: Operational-only. Derived from type at write time and independently re-validated for consistency on read. Absent on every legacy document.

fields.label: Tracking Mode
fields.description: Operational-only. The moving Part's tracking mode at write time, mirrored from partTrackingMode.js's PART_TRACKING_MODES. Absent on every legacy document.

fields.label: Serial #
fields.description: Operational-only, and legal ONLY when trackingMode is SERIAL (validateOperationalMovementEvent rejects it otherwise). Absent everywhere else.

fields.label: Lot #
fields.description: Operational-only, and legal ONLY when trackingMode is LOT. No live writer has ever populated it — a real, named gap; see the file header.

fields.label: Idempotency Key
fields.description: Operational-only. Caller-supplied replay-detection identity, not a human-facing reference. Absent on every legacy document.

fields.label: Occurred At
fields.description: Operational-only. Caller-supplied business time, epoch milliseconds — never a Firestore Timestamp. Absent on every legacy document.

fields.label: Recorded At
fields.description: Operational-only. Server-authored (Timestamp.fromDate(now) in serializeOperationalMovement()); a caller-supplied recordedAt is explicitly rejected. Absent on every legacy document, which carries `timestamp` instead — see the file header.

fields.label: Fingerprint
fields.description: Operational-only. A 16-hex payload hash (fingerprintMovement()) used only to distinguish a genuine replay from an idempotency-key conflict. Not human-meaningful; not filterable or sortable.

objects.label: Inventory Adjustments
objects.description: An append-only audit record of a human-initiated inventory adjustment (Receive Stock / Adjust Stock / Correct Mistake) — a separate companion trail to the inventory_transactions ledger, never a second source of stock-movement truth. See the file header.

fields.label: Action ID
fields.description: The Firestore document id, auto-generated. Not written into the document body by the sole writer.

fields.label: Part
fields.description: The Part this action concerns. Present on every stored document — the registered `part` entity exists.

fields.label: Action Type
fields.description: This entity is identityMode SYSTEM_ONLY — transactionType is NOT identity, it is the first field a composed description should draw from. See the file header. Validated by recordInventoryAction() against INVENTORY_ACTION_TYPE, not by firestore.rules (no field-level validation on this collection).

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: A signed, non-zero unit count (recordInventoryAction() rejects zero). Positive on RECEIVE_STOCK (enforced > 0); may be positive or negative on ADJUST_STOCK/CORRECT_MISTAKE. Never a monetary amount.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Optional free text on RECEIVE_STOCK/ADJUST_STOCK; required (with notes) on CORRECT_MISTAKE (recordInventoryAction()'s own validation). Stored null when blank, never an empty string.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Optional free text on RECEIVE_STOCK/ADJUST_STOCK; required (with reason) on CORRECT_MISTAKE (recordInventoryAction()'s own validation). Stored null when blank, never an empty string.

fields.label: Created By
fields.description: Actor uid claimed by the writing client (auth.currentUser?.uid ?? null) — NOT validated by firestore.rules against request.auth.uid on this collection. A client-supplied claim, not a server-authoritative fact. See the file header.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds, stamped by makeCollectionStore().add() as Date.now() in the caller's browser — never FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), never a Firestore Timestamp. No updatedAt/updatedBy — this document is never updated after creation (allow update, delete: if false).

objects.label: Purchase Orders
objects.description: The reorder-request execution record recording a purchase was placed with a supplier — reorder_purchase_orders, 1:1 with a Reorder Request, doc id == reorderRequestId. Not the dormant Epic-5 purchase_orders collection — see the file header.

fields.label: Reorder Request
fields.description: The Firestore document id, also written into the document body. Enforced equal to the doc id by firestore.rules at create.

fields.label: Part
fields.description: The single Part this Purchase Order concerns — there is no multi-line order shape on this record. Not filtered — see the file header.

fields.label: Supplier
fields.description: Required, non-empty (firestore.rules). A plain name string, not a supplierId — no `supplier` entity is registered in this program.

fields.label: External PO #
fields.description: Required, non-empty (firestore.rules). The supplier's own external document number, transcribed by a Parts Associate — NOT server-allocated, NOT enforced unique. The nameField half of identity; see the file header for why this is not referenceField and why no PO-YYYY-###### exists.

fields.label: Ordered Qty
fields.description: Required, > 0 (firestore.rules). A unit count, not a monetary amount — no money is stored on this record at all.

fields.label: Ordered Date
fields.description: Required, non-empty string. A plain YYYY-MM-DD calendar date (HTML date input), not a Firestore Timestamp.

fields.label: Expected Arrival
fields.description: Optional — null or a plain YYYY-MM-DD calendar date (firestore.rules: `== null || is string`), never a Firestore Timestamp.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Exactly one legal value, enforced at create and immutable thereafter (`allow update, delete: if false`). VOIDED lives on the LINKED reorder_requests document plus a separate reorder_purchase_order_voids record, never on this field. The OPEN/RECEIVED/VOIDED/ORPHAN view status is computed, not stored — see the file header.

fields.label: Created By
fields.description: Actor uid, enforced equal to the writer's own uid at create (firestore.rules). Every stored record carries one.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds (`Date.now()` in recordPurchaseOrder()), never a Firestore Timestamp. No updatedAt/updatedBy — this document is never updated after creation.

objects.label: Receiving
objects.description: The governed receipt record for inbound stock — receiving_orders. Backend-private: deny-all in firestore.rules, staged only by the trusted receiveInventoryStock command inside its own transaction. No read path (client or callable) exists anywhere in this repository today. Identity is receivingOrderNumber (RO-YYYY-######), server-allocated by a numbering lane not yet built and absent on every existing document — see the file header.

fields.label: Receiving Order ID
fields.description: The Firestore document id, also written into the document body. Server-derived — "rcv_" + sha256(idempotencyKey).slice(0, 40) — never accepted from input.

fields.label: Receiving Order
fields.description: RO-YYYY-######, the identity.referenceField per the Owner's identity-modes ruling (A-IDENTITY-MODES, X-PROCUREMENT-ENTITIES-NO-IDENTITY). Server-allocated at creation by a numbering lane that does not yet exist — no allocateReceivingOrderNumber (or equivalent) is implemented anywhere in this repository. ABSENT ON EVERY EXISTING (LEGACY) receiving_orders document. A renderer must not fall back to the Firestore document id (receivingId) when this field is missing; an honest empty/placeholder state is required instead, per the Owner's ruling that documentId must never be exposed while legacy references are absent.

fields.label: Schema Version
fields.description: Storage-schema discriminator (RECEIVING_SCHEMA_VERSION). Currently always 1.

fields.label: Source Type
fields.description: Stored at `source.type`. Exactly one legal value today (receivingTypes.ts's RECEIVING_SOURCE_TYPES) — not filterable, the same restraint purchaseOrder.js applies to its own single-value status.

fields.label: Source Reorder Request
fields.description: Stored at `source.reorderRequestId`. The Reorder Request this receipt is against.

fields.label: Source Purchase Order
fields.description: Stored at `source.purchaseOrderId`. Equal to sourceReorderRequestId by the 1:1 doc-id invariant (receivingTypes.ts's own comment: "== reorderRequestId (spec §2)").

fields.label: Receiving Location Type
fields.description: Stored at `receivingLocation.type`. Pinned to exactly WAREHOUSE by receivingCallables.ts's own input guard — see the file header for why this is narrower than the shared LocationRef vocabulary.

fields.label: Receiving Location
fields.description: Stored at `receivingLocation.locationId`. Safe to declare REFERENCE to `warehouse` because receivingLocationType is pinned to WAREHOUSE — see the file header.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: receivingTypes.ts's ReceivingOrderValue.status is the TypeScript literal "PUTAWAY_COMPLETE" — the first slice creates directly at this one status (spec's fuller EXPECTED/CHECKED_IN/PUTAWAY_COMPLETE/CANCELLED lifecycle is specified for later multi-step gates, not yet reachable). Not filterable — the same "exactly one legal value" restraint purchaseOrder.js applies to its own status.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: RECEIVING_INITIAL_VERSION. Currently always 1 — the first slice writes no later version.

fields.label: Idempotency Key
fields.description: Caller-supplied opaque replay-safety key (receivingCallables.ts validates only non-blank). Not a human-facing name — see the file header.

fields.label: Actor Kind
fields.description: Stored at `actor.kind`. Server-authored from the trusted caller's actor, never accepted from untrusted input.

fields.label: Actor ID
fields.description: Stored at `actor.id`. The acting uid (kind USER) or system identifier (kind SYSTEM). Same value as createdBy/updatedBy below.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: A real Firestore Timestamp (Timestamp.fromDate(now)) — see the file header for why this differs from reorderRequest.js's/purchaseOrder.js's epoch-millisecond NUMBER fields.

fields.label: Created By
fields.description: == actor.id. Every stored record carries one.

fields.label: Updated
fields.description: A real, written field — but always equal to createdAt, since this document is only ever created (txn.create()), never updated. See the file header.

fields.label: Updated By
fields.description: A real, written field — but always equal to createdBy, for the same reason as updatedAt. See the file header.

fields.label: Fingerprint
fields.description: A 16-hex sha256 digest over the request-derived value (fingerprintReceivingOrder()) — a technical replay/idempotency checksum, not a human identity. See the file header.

objects.label: Transfer Orders
objects.description: The Enterprise Inventory Phase 4 operating record moving stock between two Locations (WAREHOUSE/MOBILE only). Identity is transferOrderNumber (TO-YYYY-######), server-allocated by a numbering lane not yet built and absent on every existing document — see the file header.

fields.label: Transfer Order ID
fields.description: The Firestore document id: "trf_" + sha256(idempotencyKey).slice(0,40) (transferOrderDocId), a deterministic replay key, never a caller-supplied slug. NOT written into the document body — serializeTransferOrder omits it, and toTransferRef()/deserializeTransferOrder both treat a stored `id` field as untrusted, failing closed on any conflict rather than trusting it. Not part of identity — see the file header.

fields.label: Transfer Order
fields.description: TO-YYYY-######, the identity.referenceField per the Owner's identity-modes ruling (A-IDENTITY-MODES, X-TRANSFER-ORDER-NO-REFERENCE). SERVER-ALLOCATED AT CREATION, and the allocator is LIVE: allocateTransferOrderNumber (functions/src/inventoryTransfer/transferOrderNumbering.ts) is called by createTransferOrder inside its transaction and serialized onto the stored record. ABSENT ON LEGACY transfer_orders documents that predate the allocator — no backfill has run. A renderer must not fall back to the Firestore document id when this field is missing; an honest empty/placeholder state is required instead, per the Owner's ruling that documentId must never be exposed while legacy references are absent.

fields.label: Part
fields.description: The single Part this Transfer Order moves — Phase 4 is single-part per order. Not filtered — no query narrows by it today.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: REQUESTED / IN_TRANSIT / COMPLETED / CANCELLED. Filterable/sortable as a forward-looking declaration — see the file header.

fields.label: From Warehouse
fields.description: Legacy scalar, written ONLY when both origin and destination are WAREHOUSE (serializeTransferOrder). Absent on a WAREHOUSE<->MOBILE transfer. Also the field firestore.rules reads for the read-authorization OR-check — see the file header. Not filterable — no query narrows by it today.

fields.label: To Warehouse
fields.description: Legacy scalar, written ONLY when both origin and destination are WAREHOUSE — see fromWarehouseId and the file header.

fields.label: Tracking Mode
fields.description: Stored on every document — see the file header for why this contradicts an earlier, still-committed governance comment on this same collection.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: A unit count at CREATE time (== serialNumbers.length when SERIAL-tracked), never re-derived from ledger events. See the file header.

fields.label: Idempotency Key
fields.description: The caller-supplied replay key this Transfer Order was created with. Internal; not business data a person reads.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Starts at 1 (INITIAL_VERSION); incremented by transitionFields on every status transition. Not filterable or sortable — nothing scans by it.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: A real Firestore server Timestamp (Timestamp.fromDate in serializeTransferOrder), never epoch milliseconds.

fields.label: Created By
fields.description: Actor uid (actor.id at create). Every stored record carries one.

fields.label: Updated
fields.description: A real Firestore server Timestamp, updated by transitionFields on every status transition. Never epoch milliseconds.

fields.label: Updated By
fields.description: Actor uid of the most recent transition (create or status change).

fields.label: Fingerprint
fields.description: 16-hex sha256 over the CREATE value (fingerprintTransferOrder), used only to distinguish an applied write from a replay. Internal; not business data.

objects.label: Equipment / Installed Base
objects.description: An installed, customer-serviceable asset at one Account Location, moving through a governed ACTIVE/INACTIVE/RETIRED lifecycle. Not the equipment_models compatibility catalog — see the file header.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: The human reference for this asset (firestore.rules' own comment names it so). Not enforced unique — duplicate names within an Account are real-world and allowed.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: ACTIVE / INACTIVE / RETIRED. An ordinary client edit may only move ACTIVE<->INACTIVE; reaching or leaving RETIRED is trusted-writer-only (firestore.rules equipmentTransitionAllowed).

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: The owning Account. Immutable after create (not in equipmentEditableKeys) — reassignment is not an ordinary edit.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: The installed Location, within the same Account. Immutable on this path — a Location change is the audited MOVE action, not an ordinary edit.

fields.label: Manufacturer
fields.description: Optional, string | null (Spec §1).

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Optional, string | null (Spec §1).

fields.label: Serial Number
fields.description: Optional, string | null, and NOT enforced unique — looks like a business reference but is not one. See the identity note in the file header.

fields.label: Asset Tag
fields.description: Optional, string | null, and NOT enforced unique — see the identity note in the file header.

fields.label: Installed
fields.description: Optional, string | null — a plain YYYY-MM-DD calendar date (HTML date input), not a Firestore Timestamp.

fields.label: Warranty Expires
fields.description: Optional, string | null — a plain YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, not a Firestore Timestamp.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Optional, string | null (Spec §1).

fields.label: Created
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds (firestore.rules asserts `is number`), never a Firestore Timestamp. No createdBy is stored — see X-EQUIPMENT-PROVENANCE-GAP.

fields.label: Updated
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds, never a Firestore Timestamp. No updatedBy is stored — see X-EQUIPMENT-PROVENANCE-GAP.

objects.label: Invoices / AR
objects.description: The immutable ISSUED invoice record following a billable Sales Order. Deny-all in Rules; read only through the governed listAccountInvoiceAr callable.

fields.label: Invoice
fields.description: INV-######, server-allocated per company at creation (allocateInvoiceNumber) and immutable. Returned by listAccountInvoiceAr's projection.

fields.label: State
fields.description: DRAFT/SENT are declared in the shared vocabulary but unreachable by any write path today — see the file header. Not filterable: no query anywhere filters invoices by state.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Free-form string (e.g. "USD"); the code the CURRENCY_MINOR amounts below are denominated in.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: The scope listAccountInvoiceAr actually queries by (`.where("accountId", "==", accountId)`).

fields.label: Sales Order
fields.description: Written once at issuance (issueInvoice cross-checks it against the governed Sales Order). Preserves the Sales Order -> Invoice lineage.

fields.label: Due Date
fields.description: Ms epoch, carried (not computed) at issuance — AR aging begins here. A plain number in storage, never a Firestore Timestamp (invoiceCommands.ts's isInt guard), but a DATE by kind — see cellValue's DATE/TIMESTAMP handling.

fields.label: Issued
fields.description: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), set once in persistIssuedInvoice. The record's real creation-time provenance field. Not in listAccountInvoiceAr's current projection — see the file header.

fields.label: Issued (ms)
fields.description: A plain `Date.now()` snapshot captured moments before issuedAt commits, inside the same transaction (InvoiceRecord's own field). A near-duplicate of issuedAt at lower precision, not a second event. Not in the current read projection.

fields.label: Updated
fields.description: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), set by applyPayment / recordInvoiceAdjustment / recordRefund whenever one of them patches the AR projection. Sparse — absent until the first such write. No updatedBy exists anywhere; see the file header.

fields.label: Total
fields.description: The authoritative invoice total, recomputed server-side at issuance from the committed Sales Order unit-price snapshot + injected tax. Integer minor units, never a float.

fields.label: Outstanding
fields.description: = totalMinor at issuance; a transactionally-maintained PROJECTION thereafter (total - applied - credits + charges - writeoffs), never an independently editable authority.

fields.label: Subtotal
fields.description: Sum of line subtotals before tax/discount. Stored on the document; not in listAccountInvoiceAr's current projection — see the file header.

fields.label: Discount
fields.description: Sum of explicit governed line discounts. Stored on the document; not in the current read projection.

fields.label: Tax
fields.description: Sum of the injected per-line tax determination. Stored on the document; not in the current read projection.

fields.label: Applied
fields.description: Running sum of payment applications. Sparse — absent until the first applyPayment. See the file header.

fields.label: Credits
fields.description: Running sum of CREDIT_MEMO adjustments feeding the outstanding formula. Sparse — absent until the first recordInvoiceAdjustment of that type.

fields.label: Charges
fields.description: Running sum of DEBIT_CHARGE adjustments feeding the outstanding formula. Sparse — absent until the first recordInvoiceAdjustment of that type.

fields.label: Write-offs
fields.description: Running sum of WRITE_OFF adjustments feeding the outstanding formula. Sparse — absent until the first recordInvoiceAdjustment of that type.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The per-company scope the invoice numbering counter is keyed by (invoiceNumbering.ts). No `company` EntityDefinition is registered in this program, so this stays a plain string rather than a REFERENCE.

fields.label: Tax Provenance
fields.description: Optional provenance of the injected tax determination (audit/evidence), carried through unchanged from issuance input. Stored on the document; not in the current read projection.

objects.label: Payments
objects.description: A cash receipt recorded by the trusted applyPayment command — money received, distinct from how it is applied (see payment_applications, out of scope here). Deny-all in Rules; no read path of any kind exists today.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: Caller-supplied external reference (e.g. a check or wire number). OPTIONAL — null when not supplied, in which case this record has no human-legible name at all. See the file header for why this is nameField despite that.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Required. No `company` EntityDefinition is registered in this program, so this stays a plain string rather than a REFERENCE — the same reasoning invoice.js's own companyId field gives.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: Required. Not filterable — no read path exists to back a query of any kind (see the file header).

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Free-form string (e.g. "USD"); the code the CURRENCY_MINOR amounts below are denominated in.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: The cash amount received. Required, positive integer minor units (paymentCommands.ts's isPosInt), never a float.

fields.label: Method
fields.description: Optional, free-form (e.g. "CHECK", "ACH"). No closed vocabulary/enum exists for this field anywhere in the codebase, so it is declared STRING rather than an invented ENUM.

fields.label: Received
fields.description: Ms epoch, CALLER-SUPPLIED (the actual date the cash was received, which may be in the past). A plain number, never a Firestore Timestamp. Distinct from receivedAt/createdAt below — see the file header.

fields.label: Received (server)
fields.description: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), set once at write time — identical in value to createdAt on every stored receipt (both set in the same tx.set call). See the file header for why both are declared despite the redundancy.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), set once at write time. The record's real creation-time provenance field. No createdBy exists anywhere — see the file header.

fields.label: Applied
fields.description: The portion of this receipt applied to an invoice. Always equal to amountMinor today (buildApplyPayment fully applies every receipt to one invoice) — see the file header.

fields.label: Unapplied
fields.description: The receipt's own unapplied balance. Always 0 today (over-application is rejected, not banked as a credit) — forward-compat field, see the file header.

objects.label: Users
objects.description: The authoritative workforce identity — separate from users/{uid}'s application-access identity. Linked to a User by an Admin-SDK-only, two-way pointer pair.

fields.label: Employee ID
fields.description: The Firestore document id, also written into the document body by provisionEmployeeAccess.js. Nothing enforces the two match.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: The human name every write path sets and every consumer resolves an actor uid to. The nameField half of identity.

fields.label: First Name
fields.description: Optional, string | null (spec Data model). No consumer reads this independently of displayName today.

fields.label: Last Name
fields.description: Optional, string | null (spec Data model). No consumer reads this independently of displayName today.

fields.label: Employee ID
fields.description: The BUSINESS-facing employee number, nullable. Distinct from employeeId (the technical document id) and deliberately not a governed reference: optional, unenforced, and absent on every record provisioned before this field existed.

fields.label: Middle Name
fields.description: Optional, string | null.

fields.label: Preferred Name
fields.description: Optional, string | null. What this person is called; displayName remains the identity nameField.

fields.label: Work Email
fields.description: Optional, string | null. A contact fact on the workforce record -- NOT an authentication identity (that lives in Firebase Auth against users/{uid}).

fields.label: Work Phone
fields.description: Optional, string | null.

fields.label: Mobile Phone
fields.description: Optional, string | null.

fields.label: Job Title
fields.description: Optional, string | null. Descriptive only: a job title determines no permission, no operational role and no security role.

fields.label: Manager
fields.description: Nullable employees/{employeeId} pointer to this person's manager. Validated for existence by the trusted write command; never free-form display text.

fields.label: Operating Company
fields.description: Nullable governed operating-company id (taylor | ventana today). Resolved through domain/operatingCompanyAuthority.js -- never inferred from an Account's line of business.

fields.label: Hire Date
fields.description: Optional ISO calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD), stored as a string. Not a timestamp.

fields.label: Separation Date
fields.description: Optional ISO calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD), stored as a string. Independent of EOS account status, which lives in Firebase Auth and is changed only by setUserStatus.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Nullable nested map { street, unit, city, state, postalCode }. Rendered field-by-field by the record page; v1 FIELD_TYPE has no nested-object member, so it is declared as a single field rather than approximated as five.

fields.label: Employment Status
fields.description: The authoritative Employee lifecycle field -- there is no `active` boolean anywhere in this schema (spec Design decision). ACTIVE is the only Phase 3 assignment-eligibility value.

fields.label: Operational Roles
fields.description: Multi-valued: an Employee can hold more than one operational role. Eligibility markers for assignment, never a security role (see securityRole below).

fields.label: Legacy role
fields.description: Denormalized, READ-ONLY mirror of the LEGACY users/{uid}.role (Section 8a) -- not the governed Roles this person holds, and not written by any governed command. Rendered, not filtered -- see the header. May be null/missing on records provisioned before this mirror existed.

fields.label: Linked User
fields.description: Nullable link to users/{uid} (spec Data model). Written exclusively by provisionEmployeeAccess.js; no `user` entity is registered in this program yet.

fields.label: Created
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds (provisionEmployeeAccess.js writes Date.now()), never a Firestore Timestamp. No createdBy is stored -- see the header.

fields.label: Updated
fields.description: Epoch milliseconds, never a Firestore Timestamp. No updatedBy is stored -- see the header.
